truepass's ESLint plugin: the ways a test suite is made to pass without the code passing.

```ts
import { rules, plugin, configs, … } from 'truepass/eslint';
```

## Constants

### configs

`recommended`: every rule as an error. `adoption`: every rule as a warning, for a repo
paying down a backlog with `--max-warnings` as the ratchet.

```ts
const configs: {
    recommended: Linter.Config<import("@eslint/core", { with: { "resolution-mode": "require" } }).RulesConfig>;
    adoption: Linter.Config<import("@eslint/core", { with: { "resolution-mode": "require" } }).RulesConfig>;
};
```
